decision.summary: Two regions warrant closer inspection: (1) an early abrupt N-axis drop with unclear recovery, and (2) a sustained high-amplitude displacement onset near index 605 with ambiguous internal structure. No clear temporary offsets or clean opposing returns are evident; morphology suggests overlapping permanent shifts and possible platform behavior.

regions.observation: Cross-axis shape shows a multi-sample abrupt drop in N (from ~-0.1 to ~-2.9) around index 384–386, followed by sustained low-N values; E and U show correlated but less coherent fluctuations—possible opposing return not clearly resolved due to coarse sampling.

Large-amplitude, multi-day coherent shift in all axes beginning near index 605 (N/E/U ~5.7/8.2/-18.3), with persistent elevated values through index 729; includes a possible platform-like segment from ~610–640 before further drift—ambiguous whether this is a single offset or superposed changes.
